beats.text: If you want to build this, start with SAM from **transformers**, and freeze it.
Add low-rank updates and adapters that start at **zero**. Then the model must equal plain SAM. Our check gave a difference of exactly **zero**.
Hugging Face insists on a **thousand and twenty-four** pixel input. Call the patch convolution directly, and resize the position embedding.
Take the features from blocks **six**, nine and twelve.
Build the Mamba U-Net. Use the official CUDA scan and V Mamba weights if you can. Our PyTorch scan matched the slow one to about **one e minus six**.
Check the gradients. The Laura down matrices get **zero** gradient at the first step. That is normal, because the up matrices start at zero.
Then overfit one batch before anything else. We reached a Dice of **point nine nine three** on one image. That proves the wiring, not the accuracy.
